title.zh: 'It's Now or Never' for Clarity Act, Says 'Bitcoin Senator' Lummis
title.en: 'It's Now or Never' for Clarity Act, Says 'Bitcoin Senator' Lummis

current_state.zh: The Senate holds a cloture vote on the Clarity Act with a 60-vote threshold, as Sen. Cynthia Lummis argues the revised bill already incorporates over 120 Democratic demands and warns the window for passage is closing.
